_note: Agent Spec §3: three worked examples (confident, partial, abstention). None of these questions appear in the gold set. Each example is replayed as a full tool-use exchange: search call -> passages -> submit_answer.

question.text: What happens if an employee's laptop is lost or stolen?

search.query: lost or stolen laptop device procedure

passages.title: Endpoint & Asset Management Standard
passages.text:
5.1 Personnel must report a lost or stolen device to the Security team immediately.

5.2 The Security team remotely locks the device and revokes its sessions. If the device is not recovered, it is remotely wiped.

submit_answer.answer: Employees must report a lost or stolen device to the Security team immediately. The Security team then remotely locks the device and revokes its sessions, and remotely wipes it if it is not recovered.

citations.passage: Personnel must report a lost or stolen device to the Security team immediately.
The Security team remotely locks the device and revokes its sessions. If the device is not recovered, it is remotely wiped.

submit_answer.reasoning_note: KB-27 §5 directly describes the reporting and response steps.

question.text: Is your incident response plan tested, and are the test results shared with customers?

search.query: incident response plan testing tabletop exercise results

passages.title: Incident Response Plan
passages.text:
9.1 This plan is tested at least annually through a tabletop exercise involving Security, Engineering, Legal, and Communications.

9.3 Findings from tests are tracked to completion like post-incident actions.

submit_answer.answer: Yes, the incident response plan is tested at least annually through a tabletop exercise involving Security, Engineering, Legal, and Communications, and findings are tracked to completion. Our documents do not say whether test results are shared with customers.

citations.passage: This plan is tested at least annually through a tabletop exercise involving Security, Engineering, Legal, and Communications.
Findings from tests are tracked to completion like post-incident actions.

submit_answer.reasoning_note: Testing is documented in KB-10 §9; nothing retrieved covers sharing results with customers, so that part needs a human answer.
